column1: # How people actually type Hindi in Latin letters, and what they mean by it.
# Two kinds of spelling are here, and neither is reachable from the phonetic
#  - Words the rules get wrong because Latin spelling does not carry the
#    difference: dental against retroflex ("theek" is ठीक, not थीक), a long
#    vowel nobody doubles ("pani" is पानी), nasalisation nobody writes
#  - Chat shorthand that drops letters wholesale: "h" for है, "nhi" for नहीं,
# This list matters more than its Bengali twin: Hindi ships no bundled word
# list, so until the user downloads one these lines are all the vocabulary the
# Hindi phonetic layout has. It is a hand-written draft of the commonest few
# hundred words and wants a Hindi speaker's review (issue #239).
# Format: spelling<TAB>hindi   (one mapping per line; # starts a comment)
# A spelling may repeat to offer several forms, most-preferred first.
# Loaded after en_hi.tsv, so the hand-written loanword spellings win a tie.
# --- things, places, the rest of daily life ---
